name: Saner.AI
tagline: ADHD-friendly AI personal assistant for notes, tasks, and email.
description: A personal knowledge and productivity assistant built for ADHD workflows. Its assistant, Skai, captures quick notes, auto-tags and organizes them, lets you chat over your own documents, and pulls tasks, email, and calendar into one workspace to fight context-switching and overwhelm.
insight: Niche-built for ADHD executive dysfunction rather than retrofitted from a general note app — its assistant is named Skai.

modelSupport.notes: Vendor-managed AI assistant (Skai) over the user's notes and tasks.

edge: Designed around ADHD executive function — quick capture, automatic tagging, and a single surface for notes, tasks, email, and calendar to reduce overwhelm.
pros: Chat over your own notes and docs
cons: Free plan caps AI messages and notes
Lighter inline editing than dedicated note apps
